explicit_cross_discipline_notes.note: Substantially overlaps Infectious Diseases (SU-ID-09, completed) and Neurology (N, not yet mapped); this unit is scoped to imaging-modality selection and radiographic pattern recognition only.

existing_rationale.rationale: Objective 27 covers diagnosing the cause and severity of dyspnea with emphasis on identifying life-threatening causes; acute severe asthma is one of the specific life-threatening etiologies this objective is designed to test, though the objective itself is presentation-level (dyspnea) rather than diagnosis-specific (asthma).
As with asthma (SU-ER-18), acute COPD exacerbation is one of the life-threatening dyspnea etiologies objective 27 is designed to test; no COPD-specific MCC objective exists.

Acute decompensated heart failure is a canonical life-threatening cause of dyspnea within objective 27's scope; this unit's precipitant-identification and left-/right-sided presentation content operationalizes that objective's diagnostic task.
PE is a canonical life-threatening dyspnea etiology under objective 27; the DVT-diagnosis half of this unit is supported secondarily.
Direct presentation-level match to objective 27.

explicit_cross_discipline_notes.note: Emergency Medicine (chapter ER, completed) already covers several acute dyspnea etiologies under objective 27 (SU-ER-18, SU-ER-20, SU-ER-21, SU-ER-22). FM's content is the outpatient undifferentiated-presentation angle - recorded for the global chapter-overlap audit.
